text.lead:
Adored (Italian: Poco più di un anno fa - Diario di un pornodivo, also known as Little More Than a Year Ago, Adored: Diary of a Male Porn Star and Adored: Diary of a Porn Star) is a 2003 Italian drama film written, directed and starred by Marco Filiberti.
It was screened in the Panorama section at the 2003 Berlin Film Festival.
text.plot: Life events of Riccardo Soldani aka Riki, a gay pornstar in the nineties, through the eyes of his brother.
text.cast:
- Marco Filiberti: Riccardo Soldani
- Urbano Barberini: Federico Soldani
- Rosalinda Celentano: Luna
- Francesca D'Aloja: Charlotte
- Erika Blanc: Angela
- Luigi Diberti: Rod Lariani
- Caterina Guzzanti: Koka
- Alessandra Acciai: Julie
- Cosimo Cinieri: Silvio Valle
- Giuliana Calandra: Franca Soldani
- Franco Oppini: Gigi Ralli
